== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[World Spirit]] of [[Visiria]] is a powerful entity that serves as the physical manifestation of its namesake planet. Described as possessing immense strength, the [[spirit]] is characterized by a volatile and irrational temperament, often exhibiting extreme fury. In combat, it has demonstrated terrifying capabilities, such as using multiple limbs to violently dismantle opponents. The [[spirit]] is also capable of blessing specific objects, like the The Heart of Visiria{{!}}Heart of Visiria, which functions as a potent healing tool through its channeled energies. Furthermore, the [[spirit]] plays a role in the planet's relationship with the [[Aether]]; if the [[Swarm-Queen]] were summoned, the [[World Spirits]] would provide her with sustenance until the [[Aether]] itself could be compromised.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[World Spirit]] of [[Visiria]] is a beefy entity that serves as the physical embodiment of pure fury. This being possesses three eyes that burn with the intensity of captured suns. Clad in glistening bronze armor, the [[spirit]] wields titanic thunderbolts during combat. These weapons allow it to hurl lightning bolts of red, green, blue, and white.}}
